title: Grateful Dead Live at Field House, University of Cincinnati on 1970-04-03
lineage: Used Diamond Cut/Forensics 8.1 to clean up the monitor noise (sounds like an unshielded cable) and a little of the over saturation (analog recorder clipping) on the source

ai_review.summary: Fans love this recording and rate it highly, though they give no specific details about sound or performance.
ai_review.review: All three reviewers gave the recording five‑star ratings and expressed enthusiastic appreciation, mentioning the clever file concatenation and personal connection to the show date. However, none of the reviews provide concrete information on the audio source, mix quality, or musical highlights, leaving the technical and performance aspects largely undocumented.

ai_rating.rationale: Uniform 5‑star praise indicates strong positive sentiment, but the lack of concrete details on sound quality or musical performance limits confidence in assigning a higher rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers mention that the files were concatenated into three large set files, but give no direct comments on clarity, mix balance, or source type.
